title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue that Individuals Who Illegally Manufacture or Sell Another Person's Registered Trademark Identification and Thus Constitute a Crime Shall Be Punished According to the Crime of Counterfeiting a Registered Trademark

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Court
Official Reply on the Punishment of Individuals Who Illegally Manufacture or Sell Others' Registered Trademark Labels and Constitute a Crime, Which Shall Be Punished as the Crime of Counterfeiting Registered Trademarks
May 9, 1985, Fa (Yan) Fu [1985] No. 28
Higher People's Court of Zhejiang Province:
With respect to the issue raised in your request of November 7, 1984, concerning whether an individual who illegally manufactures or purchases trademark labels of well-known products for use on other products and sells them as well-known products may be punished as the crime of counterfeiting a registered trademark, upon examination, we are of the opinion that, in accordance with Articles 4, 38, and 40 of the Trademark Law, any enterprise, institution, or individual industrial or commercial operator who counterfeits a registered trademark of another person, including the illegal manufacture or sale of a registered trademark label of another person, shall constitute an infringement of the exclusive right to use a registered trademark. Where the above act is committed and a crime is constituted, the offender may be directly convicted and sentenced in accordance with Article 127 of the Criminal Law.
Hereby reply.
